requirements.purpose: Stores professionals, portfolios, reviews, verified customer identities, engagement state, channel policies and delivery audit history.

Owns delivery of Ebolito notifications across in-app, WhatsApp, SMS, email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, push, webhooks and future supported channels. Ebolito remains the system of record and controls channel policy and escalation.
Provides bounded operational verification for marketplace, database, identity, notification routing and messaging health.
